benefits.name: 5% Cash Back at Walmart for Walmart+ Members
benefits.description: Walmart+ members earn 5% cash back at Walmart instead of the standard 3%.
benefits.terms: Requires an active paid Walmart+ membership ($98/year). Without Walmart+, Walmart purchases earn the standard 3% rate.
